title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Focusing on Key Work in the Fields of Agriculture, Rural Areas, and Farmers to Ensure the Timely Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Grasping the Key Work in the Field of Sannong to Ensure the Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects as Scheduled

Fa Fa [2020] No. 15

In order to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers (Sannong), fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the "Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Rural Work," the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Grasping the Key Work in the Field of Sannong to Ensure the Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects as Scheduled," and the "Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Law-Based Rural Areas," give full play to the trial functions of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for grasping the key work in the field of Sannong under normalized epidemic prevention and control to ensure the realization of a moderately prosperous society in all respects as scheduled, the following opinions are put forward.

I. Effectively Raise Political Stance and Enhance the Mission and Responsibility of Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Grasping the Key Work in the Field of Sannong to Ensure the Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects as Scheduled

1. Resolutely implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, and enhance the political responsibility and historical mission of serving the overall work of the Party and the state. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has made a series of major decisions and deployments around winning the battle against poverty, implementing the rural revitalization strategy, Party rural work, and building law-based rural areas, and has introduced a series of policies and measures, putting forward clear requirements for doing a good job in Sannong work in the new era. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on Sannong work, enhance "four consciousnesses," strengthen "four confidences," and achieve "two safeguards," resolutely implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, and always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in thought, politics, and action. We must firmly adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, always plan, deploy, and promote work from a political and overall perspective, and protect Sannong work with the thinking and methods of the rule of law. We must benchmark against the decisions, deployments, and work requirements of the Party Central Committee, closely combine with the actual work of the people's courts, identify the connection points and entry points for judicial services to the overall work of the Party and the state, carry out work creatively, give full play to the trial functions, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for advancing the modernization of the rural governance system and governance capacity, advancing agricultural and rural modernization, ensuring the completion of the decisive battle against poverty, and ensuring that rural areas simultaneously build a moderately prosperous society in all respects.

II. Give Full Play to the Trial Functions and Provide Strong Judicial Services and Guarantees for Grasping the Key Work in the Field of Sannong to Ensure the Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects as Scheduled

2. Deeply carry out the special campaign to combat gang crimes and root out evil forces, and create a harmonious and stable social environment. Conscientiously implement the requirements of the "Implementation Opinions of the People's Courts on Continuing to Deeply Advance the Special Campaign to Combat Gang Crimes and Root out Evil Forces in 2020" (Fa [2020] No. 52), adhere to the policy of strict punishment according to law, continuously and forcefully combat rural gang forces and clan evil forces, punish crimes involving gang crimes and evil forces in the field of Sannong according to law with speed and severity, deepen the work of "breaking protective umbrellas and networks" and "cutting off financial sources and lifelines," resolutely eradicate the soil that breeds gang crimes and evil forces in the field of Sannong and the "protective umbrellas" and "networks of connections" behind them, ensure the achievement of the goal of "long-term mechanisms for management and governance," and effectively enhance the people's sense of security and satisfaction.

3. Punish crimes involving public property in the field of Sannong according to law, and continue to carry out special governance of corruption in the field of Sannong. Severely crack down on crimes of embezzlement, misappropriation, and corruption of agricultural investment according to law, ensuring the effective use of agricultural investment. Strictly punish crimes such as interception and misappropriation that hinder the system of subsidies for grain growers according to law, effectively ensuring the timely distribution of grain subsidies. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts such as illegal encroachment on rural collective assets and poverty alleviation and agricultural benefit funds according to law, and deeply advance the anti-corruption struggle in rural areas.

4. Punish crimes involving agricultural products according to law, and effectively ensure rural food safety and the quality and safety of agricultural products. Punish crimes involving counterfeit and substandard food according to law, ensuring the "safety on the tip of the tongue" of the rural population. Punish crimes involving the production and sale of counterfeit and substandard agricultural materials according to law, strictly preventing counterfeit and substandard agricultural materials from entering the agricultural production field, and promoting quality-driven agriculture and green development. Punish crimes involving smuggling of agricultural products according to law, effectively ensuring the normal circulation order of agricultural products. Strengthen the connection between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice in the field of agricultural materials, and promote the enhancement of comprehensive agricultural law enforcement efficiency and level.

5. Punish crimes against the rights and interests of left-behind elderly, women, and children in rural areas according to law, and effectively maintain family harmony and social peace. Severely crack down on crimes such as fraud, theft, and robbery targeting empty-nest elderly in rural areas, protecting the personal and property safety of left-behind elderly in rural areas. Strictly punish crimes such as violence, abuse, sexual assault, and abduction against left-behind women and children in rural areas according to law, effectively safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of left-behind women and children in rural areas. Punish campus violence according to law, maintain campus safety, and guide the healthy growth of rural youth.

6. Punish criminal activities conducted under the guise of religion according to law, and promote the consolidation of rural grassroots political power. Increase the intensity of punishment for various types of illegal religious activities in rural areas, severely crack down on organized and used cult organization criminal activities according to law, prevent cults from infiltrating rural areas, and prevent the spread of feudal superstitions. Through circuit trials, legal publicity, and other means, educate and guide the majority of religious believers to correctly understand and handle the relationship between national law and religious teachings, enhance legal awareness, and improve the concept of the rule of law.

7. Properly hear cases involving agricultural infrastructure and basic public services according to law, and help accelerate the filling of short boards in rural infrastructure and public services. Properly hear cases involving rural infrastructure construction such as "four good rural roads" and rural human settlement environment improvement, increase the protection of the interests of investors in construction projects such as small-scale farmland water conservancy facilities and small watershed comprehensive management, and promote the construction and development of rural infrastructure. Properly hear dispute cases such as medical insurance and endowment insurance in rural areas according to law, and promote the construction of the rural social security system.

8. Properly hear cases involving rural land contracting according to law, and promote the improvement of the basic rural management system. Properly hear disputes over the separation of rural land ownership, contracting rights, and management rights ("three rights separation"), protect farmers' land contracting and management rights according to law, and ensure the long-term stability of land contractual relationships. Protect the orderly transfer of land management rights of contracted rural land according to law, and effectively safeguard the rights and interests of all parties in farmers' land contracting and management rights. Strictly implement the farmland protection system and the economical and intensive land use system, give full play to the functions of trial, severely crack down on illegal acts of encroaching on farmland, and ensure national food security.

9. Properly hear cases involving the "three rights separation" of rural homesteads and the entry of collective management construction land into the market according to law, and guarantee the reform of the rural land system. Properly hear disputes over the separation of homestead ownership, qualification rights, and use rights ("three rights separation"), and serve and guarantee the deepening of pilot reforms of the rural homestead system. Protect the transfer of use rights of rural homesteads and collective management construction land according to law, and vigorously support pilot reforms of the rural land system. Determine the invalidity of acts by industrial and commercial enterprises, individuals, and organizations occupying farmland and permanent basic farmland to build greenhouses, villas, etc., according to law, and standardize rural land use. Increase the intensity of compulsory enforcement of cases involving illegal occupation of farmland and illegal approval of land expropriation, and promote the cleanup and rectification of illegal occupation of farmland.

10. Properly hear disputes over rural collective land expropriation, demolition of farmers' houses and production facilities, and resettlement compensation according to law, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers whose land is expropriated. Strictly examine the legality of administrative acts such as land expropriation, compensation for expropriation, compulsory demolition of houses, and removal of above-ground attachments, seedlings, trees, etc., according to law, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers whose land is expropriated in terms of employment, housing, and social security, promote agricultural and rural development, and maintain rural social harmony and stability.

11. Implement the strictest ecological environmental protection system, and fight the battle against rural pollution. Hear environmental tort cases such as rural drinking water source pollution according to law, promote the treatment of rural domestic sewage and garbage, and ensure the safety of rural drinking water. Hear cases involving the protection of the ecological environment of key waters such as the Yangtze River Basin and the Yellow River Basin according to law, promote cross-regional judicial cooperation and whole-basin coordinated governance, and serve the ecological protection and systematic governance of large rivers such as the Yangtze River and the Yellow River. Hear cases involving the protection of the farmland ecosystem in farmland and key agricultural grain production areas according to law, ensure food security, and build a solid line of defense for the life and health of the people. Adhere to the concept of restorative justice, for acts that pollute or destroy farmland or change the use of basic farmland, order the responsible person to take restorative remedial measures according to law, promote the control, restoration, and utilization of farmland pollution, and adhere to the red line of farmland.

12. Increase the intensity of judicial protection of rural public cultural services, and promote the extension of basic public cultural services to rural areas. Properly hear cases involving rural public culture according to law, serve the implementation of the rural cultural talent cultivation project, support the development of local literary and art groups, and develop excellent opera and quyi, minority cultures, and folk culture. Strengthen the judicial protection of historical and cultural towns (villages), traditional villages, ethnic villages, traditional buildings, agricultural cultural heritage, and ancient and famous trees. Increase the intensity of judicial protection of intangible cultural heritage in rural areas, and promote the protection and development of intangible cultural heritage in rural areas.

13. Strengthen the trial work of intellectual property cases in the field of Sannong, and help fill the scientific and technological shortcomings in agricultural and rural development. Strengthen the trial work of intellectual property cases related to agriculture, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties according to law, and promote the transformation of agricultural technological achievements. Severely crack down on intellectual property crimes in the field of Sannong, hear intellectual property infringement and breach of contract cases in the field of Sannong according to law, and increase the protection of intellectual property in the field of Sannong, especially major agricultural technological achievements with independent intellectual property rights and new plant varieties. Increase the protection of trademarks for agricultural products, geographical indications or collective trademarks, and certification trademarks, and enhance the brand building of agricultural products.

14. Hear cases involving the protection of the rights and interests of migrant workers according to law, and enhance the sense of gain and happiness of migrant workers. Implement the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on Guaranteeing the Payment of Migrant Workers' Wages," give full play to the trial functions, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers in a timely manner according to law. Increase the intensity of trial and enforcement of wage arrears cases in government-invested projects and engineering construction fields, and effectively promote the fundamental solution to the problem of overdue wages for migrant workers. For disputes over overdue wages or labor remuneration with clear facts and clear legal relationships, as well as labor disputes involving migrant workers with property payment content, apply procedures such as advance execution, summary procedures, and small-amount expedited procedures according to law, achieving rapid case filing, trial, and enforcement, and improving the quality and efficiency of judicial protection. Strengthen equal protection for workers, and do not discriminate against workers from areas with severe epidemics or workers who have recovered from COVID-19. Strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers in terms of work-related injuries, medical care, and endowment insurance, and actively promote the integrated development of urban and rural society.

15. Properly hear disputes over the membership qualification of rural collective economic organizations according to law, and protect farmers' basic property rights. For issues of determining the membership qualification of collective organizations arising from the distribution of land compensation fees, other collective economic benefits, etc., comprehensively consider factors such as the parties' production and living conditions, household registration status, and the basic living security function of rural land for farmers to determine the relevant rights subjects. Treat whether the party has obtained other alternative basic living security as an important factor, carefully determine the loss of the party's rights subject qualification, and pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of women, children, and other groups according to law.

16. Hear cases involving poverty alleviation according to law, and serve the comprehensive victory in the battle against poverty. Properly hear cases in the fields of financial poverty alleviation, industrial development, etc., in poverty-stricken areas according to law, and create a good legal environment for comprehensively winning the battle against poverty. Properly hear cases in the fields of people's livelihood such as relocation for poverty alleviation, employment, medical care, and education of the poor population according to law, resolve disputes in a timely and effective manner, and promote the guarantee and improvement of people's livelihood. Strengthen the analysis and judgment of the judicial needs of poor areas, poor populations, and left-behind vulnerable groups, strengthen judicial docking, and provide more accurate judicial services and guarantees for the development of poor areas.

17. Increase the intensity of enforcement of cases involving agriculture, and ensure the legitimate rights and interests of all parties in a timely manner according to law. Effectively play the role of the enforcement command centers of the four-level courts, form a joint force for the enforcement of cases involving agriculture, and effectively solve the difficulty of enforcement of cases involving agriculture. Open a green channel for the enforcement of cases involving agriculture, ensuring priority in case filing and enforcement. Make full use of information technology means such as the enforcement network inquiry and control system, the joint disciplinary system for dishonesty, and the online judicial auction platform to solve the problem of finding people and property in cases involving agriculture, solve the problem of realizing the property of the person subjected to enforcement in cases involving agriculture, especially agricultural products and fresh and live items, and minimize the situation where farmers become poor or return to poverty due to the infringement of their legitimate rights and interests.

18. Increase the intensity of enforcement relief for cases involving agriculture, and effectively protect the basic rights of rural people in difficulty. Further standardize and improve the judicial relief system, for cases of child support, support for parents, maintenance, personal injury compensation, labor remuneration, etc., where the applicant is in difficulty due to the person subjected to enforcement's inability to perform, carry out enforcement relief in a timely manner according to law. Increase the intensity of criminal judicial relief, and provide timely judicial relief to victims and their close relatives who are in difficulty according to law. Strengthen cooperation between the people's courts and the insurance industry, effectively alleviate the economic burden on applicants caused by "inability to enforce," and effectively enhance the people's sense of gain. Adhere to reform and innovation, further promote the improvement of the enforcement relief system, and strive to make more applicants in distress feel judicial care.

III. Actively Participate in Grassroots Social Governance, and Help Build a Rural Governance System Combining Autonomy, Rule of Law, and Rule of Virtue

19. Strengthen legal publicity and education, and vigorously cultivate civilized rural customs, good family traditions, and simple folk customs. Adhere to the organic integration of legal principles, reason, and sentiment, pay attention to the interpretation of law and reasoning in judgment documents, achieve the effect of educating people with law, persuading people with reason, and moving people with emotion, so that the people can fully feel fairness and justice. Pay attention to strengthening rural legal publicity by releasing typical cases, carrying out circuit trials, etc., achieving the effect of trying one case and educating a group. Vigorously strengthen cooperation with news media, adopt ways and language that are popular with the people, enhance the effect of legal publicity, give full play to the guiding, evaluating, and regulating role of judicial education, and vigorously promote the core socialist values.

20. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism in the field of Sannong, and mediate and resolve rural conflicts and disputes in a timely and efficient manner. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, promote the improvement of a comprehensive mechanism for diversified prevention, mediation, and resolution of social conflicts and disputes, and effectively resolve conflicts in the bud and at the grassroots level. Adhere to the principle of giving priority to non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms, improve the pre-litigation diversified resolution mechanism for disputes involving agriculture, and promote the organic connection of mediation, arbitration, administrative adjudication, administrative reconsideration, and litigation. Improve the joint working system of people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation, give full play to the pre-litigation dispute resolution role of people's mediation and administrative mediation, and promote the establishment of a pre-mediation mechanism. Strengthen the judicial confirmation of mediation agreements involving agriculture, improve the judicial confirmation procedure, and promote the rapid handling of judicial confirmation of mediation agreements for disputes involving agriculture.

21. Give play to the important role of people's tribunals in the governance of the source of litigation, and promote the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes at the source. Fully implement the "Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Law-Based Rural Areas," give full play to the role of people's tribunals in participating in grassroots social governance, and promote the construction of law-based rural areas. Strengthen communication and collaboration between people's tribunals and grassroots state organs and autonomous organizations such as police stations, judicial offices, and villagers' committees, actively carry out comprehensive analysis and coordinated handling of conflicts and disputes, and form a working synergy. Give play to the demonstration and guarantee role of people's tribunals in the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, strengthen business guidance to various mediation organizations, and promote the improvement of the ability and level of people's mediation organizations and mass autonomous organizations in mediating and resolving conflicts and disputes. Promote the shift of the center of gravity of people's courts' participation in social governance and litigation services to the grassroots, sink more judicial resources to the grassroots, and help improve the efficiency of rural governance.

22. Strengthen the supply of judicial resources in rural areas, and promote the modernization of the rural governance system and governance capacity. Continuously implement the requirements of the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy" (Fa Fa [2018] No. 19), in accordance with the general requirements of industrial prosperity, ecological livability, civilized rural customs, effective governance, and affluent life, solidly promote the construction of the rural governance system combining autonomy, rule of law, and rule of virtue, strengthen the supply of judicial resources in rural areas, and promote the further development of rural governance in the direction of favorable autonomy, orderly rule of law, and effective rule of virtue.

IV. Continuously Deepen Reform and Innovation, and Improve the Working Mechanism for Serving and Guaranteeing the Key Work in the Field of Sannong to Ensure the Realization of a Moderately Prosperous Society in All Respects as Scheduled

23. Deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system, and actively explore new mechanisms and measures for judicial services and guarantees. Actively explore new models of trial for cases involving agriculture, in accordance with the principle of optimization, coordination, and efficiency, coordinate the promotion of internal institutional reform and the construction of trial execution organizations. Increase the intensity of judicial convenience, benefit, and benefit for the people, comprehensively promote the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, and continuously improve the ability and level of the people's courts to resolve disputes and serve the people. Promote the simplification and separation of complex and simple disputes in cases involving agriculture, the separation of heavy and light, and the separation of fast and slow tracks, improve the standards for simplification and separation, and effectively promote "fast trial of simple cases, careful trial of complex cases."

24. Improve the circuit trial system, and promote the convenient and effective resolution of disputes involving agriculture. Further improve the circuit trial working mechanism of grassroots people's courts in poverty-stricken areas, especially people's tribunals. Improve the coordination between people's tribunals and people's mediation organizations, villagers' autonomous organizations, and grassroots judicial offices, and enhance the pertinence of circuit trials. Follow the requirements of "facing rural areas, facing grassroots, facing the masses," reasonably set up circuit trial points and litigation service points, do a good job in circuit trials, and minimize the burden of litigation on the people.

25. Promote the construction of a mechanism for resolving differences in the application of law, and promote the unification of adjudication standards for cases involving agriculture. Strengthen research and guidance on disputes involving agriculture, promptly study and address prominent issues existing in the people's courts' service to Sannong work, carefully summarize experiences and practices, and improve relevant working mechanisms. Improve the system of presiding judge meetings and the adjudication committee, strengthen the analysis and combing of common, cutting-edge legal issues and typified adjudication rules in the field of Sannong, explore the establishment of adjudication guidelines for typified cases, establish a compulsory retrieval mechanism for similar cases and related cases, ensure the unification of adjudication standards and application of law in similar cases, effectively implement impartial justice, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

26. Comprehensively deepen the construction of smart courts, and promote the in-depth application of electronic litigation for disputes involving agriculture. Carefully summarize the achievements of smart courts in the fight against the epidemic, which accelerated and blossomed in multiple points during the epidemic prevention and control period, better use technologies such as 5G, big data, cloud computing, blockchain, and artificial intelligence, explore the establishment of 5G people's tribunals, and improve the ability and level of the people's courts to resolve conflicts and disputes and provide litigation services. Relying on the construction of smart litigation services, achieve full coverage of "one-stop service, one-network service, one-number service" for litigation services, let information run more, and let the parties run less. Do a good job in connecting the information platform of the litigation service guidance center with trial, enforcement, and other systems, and effectively improve the quality and efficiency of judicial work in cases involving agriculture.

April 26, 2020
